# Source-grounded recipe: Wave III — Freedom, CD1-2.
# The tape's preparatory process is expanded through the existing reusable
# components; its authored exercise remains one segment rather than being
# paraphrased here. No generic briefing, Clear Skies or extra hold is added.

@title    Remote Viewing
@level    F10
@ending   return
@pan      right
@seed     20007
@verbosity 3

# Awake preparation — must happen before the listener lies down.
use remote-viewing-intent

surf 0.55
use orientation

surf 0.30
use conversion-box

surf 0.18
use resonant-tuning
use balloon
use affirmation

surf 0.0
use relax-10
use remote-viewing
use return-one
